text:
vivian: Quick brainstorm / proposal for partner pilot gating + feedback pipeline. High level: cohort 6-10 partners; onboarding completion >=80% within 10 days; daily eval harness runs; p95 latency <500ms for 75% of requests during first 2 weeks; embedding cosine drift <0.02 over 14 days; no P0 regressions for 5 consecutive days. Open to adjust.
harry: +1 on numbers but ops constraints: cap concurrent 'heavy' partners to 2 until Dedicated autoscaling and multi-GPU routing validated. Also require partners to declare peak RPS and seq lengths in intake.
zoe: I'll own the prompt/test pack. Req: each partner supplies 12 canonical prompts across 3 personas (happy path, edge-case, adversarial), 2 embedding vectors, and 3 tool-call flows. We'll run them during onboarding and then daily smoke checks.
mohit: Legal/KMS note: intake must include a PII/regulatory checkbox. If partner requests VPC/HSM or on-prem, mark `private-preview` and route to Ops + Security for DPA/KMS provisioning. No credits until DPA signed.
claire: Success metrics suggestion: cohort median NPS >=7/10 at day-14, weekly active token median >4k for >=50% of partners, at least one actionable item (bug/feature) per partner surfaced to backlog. Run 45-min "value interview" with top-4 partners at week 2.
ops-bot: Intake template: https://internal.redwood/apply/pilot-template 8partner intake9. Auto-tags: region, workload_type, private_request.
vivian: Feedback routing idea: simple triage rules plus manual QA. Keyword mapping: "accuracy|wrong|regression" -> ML queue, "latency|timeout|crash" -> eng-runtime, "confusing|UX|docs" -> Product. Also trap `error_*` codes with regex and route to eng-sre. Weekly digest posts to #pilot-insights.
harry: Monitoring hooks needed pre-acceptance: distributed trace ID, kv-cache hit rate, batching stats, GPU util, and batching latency histogram. Suggested alerts: p95 latency > 750ms OR kv-cache hit < 30% -> immediate triage.
zoe: I'll add an eval harness template (python script + README) that runs the prompt pack and emits metrics: p50/p95 latency, success-at-rank (SAR@1,3), embedding cosine mean, and repetitiveness score. Will PR to infra repo and drop the harness README into intake doc.
mohit: Incentives: recommend flexible credits tiering: $2k credit or equivalent cloud credits for strategic partners, plus optional 6-week Dedicated trial for highest-signal partners. Legal to gate credit activation until DPA + IP terms signed.
claire: Launch gating proposal: soft private preview when 4 partners complete onboarding with no P0s for 5 days and eval harness shows stable latency and embedding drift under threshold. Broader private preview after 12 partners with cohort NPS >=7 and automated eval pass. Rollback triggers: repeatable P1 within 72h OR persistent eval failure -> canary rollback + incident review.
vivian: Operational checklist for acceptance: intake form, workload profile, prompt pack, infra whitelist, monitoring hooks enabled, eval harness running for 48h, trial SLA signed. Add a short `acceptance_notes.md` in the partner workspace with known limitations.
harry: I'll own infra gating (whitelists, Dedicated trial provisioning) and coordinate with eng-runtime for autoscale smoke.
zoe: I'll own prompt/test pack creation, harness integration, and daily smoke-run alerts. Will attach a sample `prompts.yaml` in the intake template.
mohit: I'll track legal/KMS/DPA and flag any partner needing private deployment. Also confirm data retention window and logging terms per partner.
claire: I'll run weekly partner syncs + the scorecard and own the first 4 value interviews. Will share a short scoring rubric (adoption, value, reliability, feedback quality).
vivian: Great. Who posts the recruitment message? I can draft it but prefer someone from Sales/GTM to own outreach.
claire: I'll coordinate outreach with Growth and post recruitment once we have the intake cadence.
vivian: Perfect. I'll update the pilot plan doc with these gates and add the triage rule set. Thanks everyone :tada:
ops-bot: Reminder: complete the intake form before scheduling kickoff.
